purpose: Remove cross-trial prefix-cache warming as a latency confound and repeat both method orders
prefix_cache_reset: Before every task/config/repeat; require vLLM success=true; do not reset running requests
warmup: One discarded token on the same initial Actor prompt, after reset, for both methods
within_task_prefix_sharing: Enabled; this is part of the deployed SPORK serving configuration
scope: A controlled repeated two-turn check; not full-task or held-out validation.
